eyebrow: DTU: one number, three things bundled
code:
Database Transaction Unit (DTU) =
  compute + memory + I/O, blended into one number

Pick a tier (Basic/Standard/Premium) + a DTU count -> done sizing
caption: Simple to reason about — but compute and storage can't scale independently.
DTU bundles compute+memory+I/O; vCore prices compute and storage independently.

code:
No license, want simplest sizing?          -> DTU model
Own a SQL Server license (Software
Assurance)?                                 -> vCore + Hybrid Benefit
Need independent storage scaling, or
Business Critical / Hyperscale?             -> vCore (DTU has no equivalent)
caption: Business Critical and Hyperscale exist only under the vCore model.

subtitle: The compute options that sit inside the vCore model.
